Can you confirm two things so I can get finance moving: (1) exact overrun amount on your invoice, and (2) whether you want the rate-limit bump now or only after we sign an amendment?

If you're good with the $10.5k credit + 30-day bump, I can route an amendment & DocuSign for signature and have Finance apply the credit to your next invoice.
